main.title: Hermes Agent
main.subtitle: Install and use the Hermes dashboard within POM
main.explain: Install the pinned Hermes Agent release on this node. Models deployed in POM are loaded into Hermes automatically after installation. Installation may take several minutes.
main.optional: Leave blank to choose a provider in the Hermes dashboard. Deployed POM models are listed in Hermes under the POM provider. Credentials are stored only on this node.
